title: Billing Operations Note: Monthly Application of Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan Credit during the Term
content:
On each due date of the term of a Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan, one month is applied to the covered agreement's rent charge: the locked rent net of the plan's discount for a charged month, and the full locked rent as a free month for each of the plan's free months, which are the last months of the term. A month is applied only while the plan is in active status, and each billing period once. While the term runs the agreement's rent stays at the locked rent, AutoPay drafts pause where the plan pauses them, and tenant protection fees are billed separately where the plan does not include them. After the last month the plan completes and rent returns to the agreement's monthly rent; a rate increase may be noticed to take effect on the first due date after the term where the plan allows it. A reminder is sent the plan's reminder period before the term end.

The number of months in the term, the free months, the discount, the AutoPay and protection-fee settings, the post-term increase setting and the reminder period are set for each plan.

## Prepaid credit

The plan's prepaid credit is prepaid rent not yet applied. The prepayment, when received, increases it; each monthly application, a refund or a forfeiture application decreases it. For a charged month the credit falls by the locked rent net of the discount. For a free month the full locked rent of that billing period is covered as a free month and the amount applied from the credit is $0.00.

The months applied on a plan are counted from the term start date up to and including the day in question; each applied month, charged or free, counts once.

## Conditions for an application

| Condition | Holds | Application on the due date |
|---|---|---|
| Plan status is active, and the billing period has not yet had a month applied | Yes | One month is applied |
| Plan status is not active (pending payment, completed, ended early, forfeited or cancelled) | — | No month is applied |
| The billing period has already had its month applied | — | No second month is applied |

## Worked term (hypothetical plan and rent)

A plan covering 12 billing periods, of which 1 is free, with a 5% discount and a locked rent of $129.00, term starting on a 1 January due date.

| Due date | Month of term | Kind | Applied from the prepaid credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 January to 1 November (11 due dates) | 1 to 11 | Charged | $122.55 each ($129.00 less 5%) |
| 1 December | 12 | Free (last month of the term) | $0.00; the $129.00 rent for the period is covered as a free month |

After the 1 December application every month has been applied; when the term ends the plan completes, and from the first due date after the term, 1 January, rent is the agreement's monthly rent, which a rate increase noticed to take effect on that due date may change where the plan allows it.

On each of these due dates the agreement's rent for that period is the locked $129.00; with protection fees not included in this hypothetical plan, any tenant protection fee on the unit is billed separately.

## Plan statuses in this note

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Completed | Every prepaid month has been applied and the term has ended |
